name: r_zl_freeplay_day_city_loot_mcw
description: Current-source integrated free-play account: begin from the released evacuation-shelter world and make ordinary daytime city-looting choices. The staged world supplies no encounter conclusion; a naturally chosen city route must expose any stalker opportunity through native movement, attacks, and player consequences.

steps.label: settle_day_city_freeplay
steps.expected_visible_fact: the disposable released world loads before free play

steps.label: audit_day_city_start_time
steps.abort_reason: the account did not begin from its declared daytime footing

steps.label: operate_day_city_freeplay
steps.objective: Choose and complete an ordinary daytime city-looting route with only currently advertised native actions. Make tactical choices from what the player can see: take cover, retreat, fight, or keep moving as conditions warrant. Do not seek a scripted stalker trigger or use diagnostics to choose the route. Preserve actual movement, time, entities, attacks, player effects, and the first surprising or absent predator consequence.
proof_targets: ordinary player-selected city movement and time
any stalker identity and physical opportunity
stalker timing feel assessed from the player-visible situation
invariants: fixture and time footing are zero-credit setup
planner strings do not replace native physical behavior
the player route is not a scenario-scripted decision sequence

steps.label: save_and_exit_day_city_account
steps.objective: Use the native save-and-quit path, then native Main-menu Quit and confirmation, preserving the account's lifecycle boundary before cleanup.
steps.expected_visible_fact: the ordinary-play account saves, reaches Main menu, and its owned process exits

evidence_contract.claim: one separate current-source ordinary daytime city-looting account supplies an honest integrated assessment of stalker timing, including a preserved inconclusive result if no valid opportunity emerges
evidence_contract.writeback_note: the released-world fixture starts an account but grants neither natural encounter credit nor an outcome; only the player-selected native route does
